items.title: The Backrooms Darkness
items.creator: Float Studios
items.description:
Noclip once more into The Backrooms. Delve deep into the Skin Stealer’s domain, collect Frank Faceling’s notes and piece together the story of The Backrooms to finally escape once and for all. 

+ Explore Level Fun, Waiting Rooms and Sewer levels!
+ Discover 4 secret levels!
+ Escape The Skin Stealer and Smilers.
+ Find 30 notes!
+ Multiple Endings!

items.title: Emoticons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Made for those who like to sketch their reactions!

+ Perfect for RPG enthusiasts
+ 10 Skins for expressing your feelings while playing

Made by Saturn Studios, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Cozy Crew
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Looking for a mix of style and comfort? Stay warm with soft textures, relaxed fits, and earthy tones. Whether you're hanging out or exploring, these laid-back styles will keep you feeling great!

+ 2 Free Skins!
+ Casual and cozy outfits
+ 10 unique characters
Made by Luminance, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Furniture
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Add FURNITURE ADD-ON to ANY WORLD. Choose from 3000+ craftable furniture pieces and customize them with vanilla dyes and logs!

+ Compatible with vanilla dyes and logs
+ 3000+ craftable decorative furniture
+ Survival Friendly
+ Made by Miracles Studios, published by Waypoint Studios

items.title: More Simple Structures
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Discover NEW naturally spawning structures—from small ruins to ancient jungle pyramids—crafted to be minimalistic while staying true to the vanilla style.

This Add-On can be applied to any world, new or existing and transform your Minecraft experience!

+ 40+ Structures
+ 3 mobs
+ Balanced loot & spawn rates

Made by CoreBlock Studios, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: DARK ANOMALY
items.creator: Teplight
items.description: Step into the world of anomaly with the Dark Anomaly Skins! Discover colorful and spooky skins, find your anomaly and be the strongest among your friends!

items.title: Anime Pirates HD
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Argh, do you want to join the pirates on the search for legendary treasures? Choose your favorite character and join the adventures of the pirates!

- By RareLoot

items.title: Sword Art HD
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Have you always wanted to become a master of the sword and experience endless adventures? Then this skinpack gives you the chance to become one of your heroes!

- By RareLoot

items.title: Block Hunt
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A beloved hide and seek minigame has returned! Select and morph into a block and blend with the environment while the seekers try to find you! Be the last one standing and become the winner in the ultimate hide and seek experience!

-Morph into an array of blocks
-Blend in the environment
-By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Sailors HD
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Become one of the magical guardians and defend the world against the darkness! Choose your favorite character and join the fight!

- By RareLoot

items.title: Hardcore Oneblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
All the mobs are now aggressive.
- Customisable difficulty.
- No natural regeneration.
- No reappearance after death.
- The day never rises.
- Multiplayer supported.

Ready to take on the ultimate Hardcore Oneblock challenge?

items.title: More Custom Blocks 2 Add-On
items.creator: MrAniman2
items.description:
More Custom Blocks 2 Add-On opens new possibilities to enhance your creative builds or improve your survival base with lots of custom blocks! There are some new building blocks, 2 multi-block structures (mini puzzles), and tons of decorations. All of them have crafting recipes and are fully compatible with survival mode!

Also, all of these are actual blocks, not entities!

items.title: Inferno Warriors
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Light up like lava when you gear up in flaming Inferno Warriors skins. Role-play with friends as fiery fighters in glowing red, yellow, and orange textures. Show off your magma armor and be ready to defend and attack as necessary. Look like you’re going to bring real heat down on your enemies!

+ 8 blazing, battling HD skins

items.title: Singers Crew
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
This skin pack brings together the greatest icons of rhythm, flow, and the energy that moves crowds. From urban style to the elegance of the most legendary stages, each skin captures the essence of a star who changed music forever!

- 18 Skins
- Ideal for role-playing!

items.title: Magical Friends
items.creator: Black Arts Studios
items.description:
Dive into magic and friendship with 12 colorful and stylish skins. Enjoy new adventures, share unique moments, and stand out with every magical outfit.

-Includes 12 Skins
-By: Black Arts Studios

items.title: Venoms Crew
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
The symbiote has evolved... and now you can take it with you. This skin pack brings together the most fearsome characters inspired by this universe! Look like a fusion of creature and warrior, and feel the power coursing through your body!

- 25 Skins
- Ideal for role-playing!

items.title: Ancestral Crew
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Step back into the glory of ancient empires with this amazing skin pack! Turn yourself into fearless warriors, insightful shamans, and epic leaders destined to leave a legacy of greatness!
12 Skins

items.title: Spectral Warriors
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Protect your realm or seize new lands with flair! Take charge as the wraith commander, strike fear into your foes, and show the world that nothing outmatches the might of an undying knight!
12 Skins

items.title: Masked Crew
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
What’s hiding behind the mask? Combining the classic essence of legendary mobs with the charm of a cryptic masked adventurer! From the stealthy Enderman to the explosive Creeper, each skin lets you spin a tale of mystery and thrill with your squad!
13 Skins

items.title: Obsidian Summer
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Summer just got epic with Obsidian Summer Friends! Imagine characters with a mysterious glow, inspired by Minecraft's most powerful rock, enjoying adventures in the sun!

- 12 Skins

items.title: Mushroom Friends
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Immerse yourself in magical nature with this pack of skins full of energy and fun! Each character sports an outfit inspired by different types of mushrooms, with bright colors and unique details that will make you look spectacular!

- 12 Skins!

items.title: Vice Style
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Are you ready to rule the streets in style? This skin pack brings the best of '80s fashion: shiny outfits, sunglasses, and gravity-defying hairstyles! Ready to move through neon-lit streets!

- 12 Skins

items.title: Kawaii Build Set 2.5
items.creator: DeliSoft Studios
items.description:
Add a splash of cuteness to your builds with the Kawaii Build Set Add-On Pack! This pack introduces adorable new blocks with pastel colors, heart and star patterns, soft textures, and playful designs. Perfect for creating dreamy cafes, cozy bedrooms, or magical villages full of charm and personality! 

+Survival/Creative Mode
+287 New Blocks
+5 NPC
items.changelog: Updated Guidebook, Light, Door & State Systems. Added Block-to-Item, Clock, Trashcan, Sitting, stable Slab, NPC removal + Spawn Egg drops. Updated recipes, block names & Spawn Egg textures. Fixed identifier. New Marketing/Store Art, 287 blocks, 5 NPCs.
items.howToTitle: Craft DSS Crafting table then open DSS Crafting table in survival mode. It should show all possible craftable on addon

items.title: Goth Core
items.creator: Aliquam Studios
items.description:
Dress your character in true Goth Core style with dark outfits, sharp white accents, and striking crowns. Stand out with a bold, mysterious look.

+ 8 gothic skins in a dark aesthetic
+ 1 free skin
+ By Aliquam Studios!
